ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey regions to low-intensity black/dark-grey regions across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density black mottling and circular ring patterns superimposed on a white ground. Significant dark pigment concentration in the medial region surrounding the notch and along the distal trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations and jagged pixel-level variations along the entire trailing edge boundary, with prominent peaks near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edge curve transitioning to sharp, upward-tapering tips with a generally concave trailing edge sweep toward the center.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread spatial distribution of circular high-contrast 'ring' patterns and dark clusters across both lobes, particularly concentrated in the upper quadrants.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark linear streaks observed on the right lobe and center-left region, cutting across the primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of active barnacle colonies attached to the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; extensive irregular chipping and tissue loss along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density concentration of 'cookie-cutter' style circular scars distributed symmetrically across the central regions of both fluke lobes.
